name: Napier City Council
story: A 2003 presentation by GIS Administrator Simon Nitz traces Napier’s MAPiT browser GIS through MapXtreme 2, 3 and 4, MapInfo Encounter, Java applets, XML/XSLT and an image viewer. It describes an internal environment with 109 Encounter users linked to SQL Server, Hansen IMS and a Unix corporate system, with MAPiT available on the intranet, at the public counter and on the internet.

sources.label: Simon Nitz, “A Napier Encounter!”, Brisbane User Forum, 11 July 2003 (later repost)
